name: app.astrocartographymap/astrocartography
title: AstrocartographyMap — Planetary Line & Relocation Calculator
description: Calculate astrocartography planetary lines (MC/IC/AC/DC) and evaluate relocation coordinates.

tools.name: calculate_astrocartography_lines
tools.description: Compute astrocartography planetary lines (MC, IC, AC/AS, DC/DS) from a birth date, local time, timezone, and reference coordinates using the astronomical ephemeris engine. Returns MC/IC meridian longitudes, horizon AC/DC longitudes at the reference latitude, planetary subpoints, zodiac signs, and nearest lines with plain-English meanings.

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. '1992-07-14'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:MM format, e.g. '08:45'. Omit if unknown (defaults to 12:00 local noon with timeKnown=false).

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for birthTime, e.g. 'America/New_York' or 'Europe/London'. Defaults to 'UTC'.

latitude.description: Reference latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90), used for horizon AC/DC longitudes and nearest-line distances.

longitude.description: Reference longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, east positive), used for nearest-line distances.

bodies.description: Optional subset of celestial bodies to compute. Defaults to all 12 bodies (sun, moon, mercury, venus, mars, jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, pluto, true_node, chiron).

dstChoice.description: Optional disambiguator when birthTime falls in a daylight saving fall-back hour ('first' or 'second').

tools.name: evaluate_location_astrocartography
tools.description: Analyze how a specific target coordinate aligns with a birth chart: returns all planetary lines within 1,000 km sorted by proximity, plain-English line descriptions, goal alignment scores (balanced, love, career, home), and the relocated Ascendant and Midheaven.

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. '1992-07-14'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:MM format, e.g. '08:45'. Omit if unknown.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for birthTime, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to 'UTC'.

latitude.description: Target location latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: Target location longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, east positive).

locationName.description: Optional human-readable label for the target location, e.g. 'Lisbon, Portugal'.

dstChoice.description: Optional disambiguator when birthTime falls in a daylight saving fall-back hour ('first' or 'second').
